name: active_exceptions_by_company_user
note: ResCompany._get_user_lock_date (addons/account/models/company.py:764-775): active exceptions per company and user on a lock date field, ordered by lock_date; read-only replay over the whole population
source_sql: SELECT id, company_id, user_id, lock_date_field, lock_date, company_lock_date, active, end_datetime FROM account_lock_exception WHERE active = true ORDER BY company_id, user_id, lock_date

name: exception_states
note: AccountLock_Exception._compute_state / _search_state (addons/account/models/account_lock_exception.py:105-135): revoked (inactive) vs still-dated exceptions, counted per company and lock date field, all rows (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT company_id, lock_date_field, active, count(*) AS exceptions, count(end_datetime) AS with_end, count(user_id) AS user_bound FROM account_lock_exception GROUP BY company_id, lock_date_field, active ORDER BY company_id, lock_date_field, active
